scope.title: Central Europe and German/Italian source families
scope.sourceStrategy: Regional/state archives and constitutional collections; establish small-state and imperial scope before statistics.
scope.priorityRationale: Early source-family batches prioritise long snapshot presence, broad period potential and national archival/constitutional collections. Source availability is a planning expectation, not an entity-by-entity research finding. Families remain indivisible; no periods are researched now.

difficultCases.question: Distinguish state, constitutional regime, constituent area, occupation zone and later republic. The existing Nazi-period mapping must not cover earlier Germany automatically.
Review composite monarchy, constituent territory and later state/regime coverage separately.
